toegepas.voor: Gras lewe in die oop veld en die springbok
toegepas.na: Gras lewe in die oop veld, en die springbok
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Gras lewe ...' and 'die springbok lewe ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both sides have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: Daar is baie soorte habitat en hulle
toegepas.na: Daar is baie soorte habitatte, en hulle
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'baie soorte' Afrikaans uses the plural noun (as the next sentence does), and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'baie soorte habitat' uses the singular where a count noun after 'soorte' reads naturally in the plural, and the clause-joining comma is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'baie soorte habitatte' matches the next sentence's 'Sommige habitatte', keeps the same word, and adds the required comma; the protected definition is untouched.

toegepas.voor: op die land en ander is in die water
toegepas.na: op die land, en ander is in die water
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb, matching the previous sentence.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Sommige habitatte is ...' and 'ander is ...'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two clauses with their own subject and verb, so the comma is required and meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: vol hoë bome en die skaduwee
toegepas.na: vol hoë bome, en die skaduwee
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'n Bos is ...' and 'die skaduwee hou ...'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full clauses; the comma before the second 'en' (in 'koel en donker') is correctly not added.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Varswater' (fresh water as a kind of water) is written as one word in the AWS.
toegepas.fout: 'vars water' in the fresh-versus-salt sense is written as one word, 'varswater'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Spelling fix only: same word, same meaning, and it sets up the salt-water contrast in the next sentence.

toegepas.voor: lewe in die water en riete groei
toegepas.na: lewe in die water, en riete groei
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining 'Die seekoei en die padda lewe ...' and 'riete groei ...'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full clauses; the list 'Die seekoei en die padda' correctly gets no comma.

toegepas.voor: Die see is baie groot en sy water is sout in plaas van vars
toegepas.na: Die see is baie groot, en sy water is sout, nie vars nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses, and 'sout, nie vars nie' is more natural Afrikaans than the English-shaped 'in plaas van vars'.
toegepas.fout: Missing clause-joining comma, and 'sout in plaas van vars' is a stiff English-shaped contrast between two adjectives.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sout, nie vars nie' is the natural Afrikaans contrast and says exactly the same thing, with the required AWS comma added.

vlae.teks: Haaie, robbe en visse lewe in die see.
vlae.rede: Listing sharks beside fish may suggest sharks are not fish; a content question for the writer or fact check, not a language fix.
